metaphor: a core sample drawn from a borehole through the patent record: depth is time, older art lies deeper, and the killing reference is a seam at a measured depth
category_convention_avoided: Patent and legal-tech tools (Patlytics, IPRally, XLSCOUT, Derwent, Anaqua) all ship a white enterprise-SaaS canvas, a left sidebar of icon+label rows, a corporate-navy accent, dense zebra-striped Inter tables, and search results as white cards each carrying a coloured relevance-score chip. The AI-agent variant of the same product adds an indigo-to-violet gradient hero and a dark console tab.
design_code: The corpus is drawn as one continuous banded column with no gaps between bands, because prior art is a continuous record in time and cutting it into cards would imply the entries are independent.

Vertical position encodes rank and band temperature encodes filing decade, because the product's entire claim is that the answer sits at a depth no human search reaches, and that has to be visible rather than asserted.
There is exactly one accent and it is reserved for a reference the model judged worth an attorney's time, because in every run the overwhelming majority of the column is not.
Numerals are tabular and every count sits in the same column position, because the funnel numbers only mean anything as a subtraction: 171,723 becomes 12,856 becomes 26.
anti_brief: Wrong: a white enterprise-SaaS canvas. It is the exact look of every incumbent this tool argues against, and adopting it concedes the argument.
Wrong: a red/amber/green relevance chip. It implies a calibrated probability the system does not have, and it is the incumbent convention.
Wrong: decorative motion such as fade-up-on-scroll. The only motion that earns a place here is descent, because descent is the argument.
expressive_axis: structure. The core column is the one loud element; everything else is restrained so the column reads as the subject rather than as a widget.

canvas.reason: Near-black is consumed by prior projects and reads as a monitor; light stock is print territory and is barred. A core is read at arm's length against unlit rock, so the field is a mid-dark mineral grey-green rather than a screen black.

strata.reason: Band temperature encodes filing decade: warm and rusted is old, cool and slate is recent. Earth tones appear only as DATA inside the column, never as the dominant canvas, because warm-neutral canvases were previously rejected by this user as drab.

palette.chroma_budget: monochrome mineral neutrals, plus one accent reserved for a single job, plus a five-step strata ramp used only for data encoding

type.voice: humanist sans with a slightly condensed, technical cast, set alongside a wide mono for figures so numbers read as measurements taken rather than values styled

structure: canvas-spatial: a fixed depth column on one side, a reading rail on the other. Not cards, not console panels, not a sidebar of icon rows.

edge.language: square for structural elements, 3px only on interactive controls
edge.reason: A core sample has no rounded corners. Radius appears only where a finger or cursor acts, so roundness marks interactivity rather than decorating containers.

depth.detail: The column is milled into the field with an inset well and a hairline lip; findings lift out of the column on a real offset. No blurred drop shadows used as elevation-for-its-own-sake.

ornament: the data itself: the strata column, the depth ruler, and the seam marks are the only decoration

motion.signature: descent. The column fills downward as Cloud Run shards report, and a seam settles into place at its measured depth when a finding lands.
motion.resting: fully static once the run completes
motion.reduced_motion: bands and seams appear at final position with no descent or settle

numerals.treatment: tabular, aligned right in a fixed column, thousands separated
numerals.zero: a zero count is rendered as a dash so absence is distinguishable from a measured zero
